title: Famous Places in the World
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, France. It is very tall. Many people visit it every year. It is made of iron.

The Great Wall of China is very long. It is in the north of China. Some parts of it are very old. You can walk on the top of the wall.

questions.text: Where is the Great Wall of China?
Why do you think many people visit the Eiffel Tower?
options: It is a famous and interesting place to see
It is a small house for families
It is a school for children
It is a shop for food

questions.text: What can you infer about the Great Wall of China?
options: It is an important and historic place
It is a new shopping center
It is a small park in a city
It is a river near the sea

vocabulary.definition: having a large height from the bottom to the top
to go to see a place or a person
a long, high structure that surrounds or divides an area

paragraph_translations: La Torre Eiffel está en París, Francia. Es muy alta. Muchas personas la visitan cada año. Está hecha de hierro.
La Gran Muralla China es muy larga. Está en el norte de China. Algunas partes de ella son muy antiguas. Puedes caminar por la parte de arriba de la muralla.
